Tired of waiting minutes for your TypeScript compiler to finish? ⏳

Meet ts-rust (pingdotgg/ts-rust) – an ambitious experimental Rust port of the TypeScript compiler, created entirely by LLMs to deliver massive type-checking speedups! 

In large monorepos and massive codebases, traditional JS-based compilation creates a massive bottleneck for local development and CI pipelines. This drop-in replacement for the standard TypeScript compiler and language server solves that by leveraging system-level performance to slash your wait times down to mere seconds—all without modifying a single line in your existing tsconfig settings. 🚀

Notable features include:
⚡ Exceptional performance: Runs roughly twice as fast as the Go-based TypeScript 7 implementation and up to 15x faster than the original JavaScript-based tsc.
🔄 Drop-in compatibility: Full command-line and API compatibility with standard tsc.
🧠 Built-in Effect diagnostics: Removes the need for a secondary compiler pass in Effect-heavy codebases.
📦 Cross-platform ready: Standalone archives and npm packaging for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

Whether you are a frontend developer, full-stack engineer, or build toolchain architect, it is time to speed up your local feedback loops and eliminate CI bottlenecks.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust

🤖 What happens when you combine autonomous LLM agents with offensive and defensive cybersecurity? 

Meet ARTEX: an award-winning, self-hosted autonomous AI penetration testing platform. It translates advanced AI capabilities directly into practical security workflows using a unified Go backend and Next.js frontend! 🚀

🛑 The Problem:
Automating cybersecurity assessments is notoriously complex. Most teams struggle to bridge the gap between theoretical LLM agent capabilities and practical security pipelines—lacking stable multi-agent orchestration, robust safety guardrails, and seamless human-in-the-loop controls.

💡 Key Features:
• Dual-Graph Architecture: Powered by the Norma SDK using a planner-worker model with shared todo lists and inter-agent communication for stable attack chains.
• Single-Binary Deployment: Features an embedded Next.js frontend, Go backend, and PostgreSQL with zero external precompiled dependencies (run locally or via Docker!).
• Advanced Security Subsystems: Includes a MITM traffic recording proxy, tool execution approval gates, and a built-in vulnerability re-testing framework that spawns independent agent sessions.

👩‍💻 Why Developers & Red Teamers Love It:
ARTEX serves as a production-grade blueprint for stateful multi-agent systems in Go. Learn how to combine LLMs with deterministic backend tasks, implement strict safety guardrails, and manage long-running agent loops securely.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/mhtsec/ARTEX

Ready to bring AI agents out of the browser and straight onto physical iOS hardware? 📱🤖

Traditional mobile automation often means dealing with heavy, complex Appium stacks or being restricted to simulators. iPhone Use changes the game by acting as a breakthrough bridge that enables Codex and LLM agents to directly control physical iPhones via a secure local USB connection. 

By integrating WebDriverAgent, local Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, and a real-time UI screen widget, it lets developers automate app navigation, text input, gestures, and UI inspections using simple natural language commands. 

Here is what makes it a must-have for your dev stack:

⚡ Local USB Pipeline: Communicates securely via standard USB connections and local loopback port forwarding without routing your data through external cloud servers.
📸 Smart Screenshot Fallback: If UI element or control tree positioning fails, the agent automatically captures a screenshot, maps pixel coordinates to iOS points, and retries using visual context.
🚀 Asynchronous Setup & State Reuse: Manages WDA installation, signing, and builds asynchronously while aggressively caching and reusing active sessions to minimize latency.
📦 Batch Operations & Compact Trees: Streamlines control trees and supports batched action sequences to reduce token overhead and round trips.

Whether you are building AI-powered personal assistants that interact with native iOS apps or setting up automated end-to-end mobile app regression testing driven by natural language, this repository gives you a ready-to-use MCP toolkit to build next-generation device automation workflows.

Check out the repo and start building today:
https://github.com/zhongerxin/iPhone-use

Tired of bloated, overpriced CAD software and vendor lock-in? Meet CADCraft: an open-source, clean-room AutoCAD-style drafting application built entirely in pure Rust. 🦀📐

Whether you are an open-source CAD developer, a systems programmer, or an AI engineer building autonomous engineering workflows, CADCraft delivers native desktop performance and browser deployment via WebAssembly with zero Electron overhead. 

Here is what makes CADCraft a game-changer for your stack:
⚡ High-performance Rust & egui: Runs natively across macOS, Windows, Linux, FreeBSD, and right in your browser via WASM.
✏️ Comprehensive 2D & 3D Drafting: Includes a command line, object snaps, associative dimensions, layers, blocks, and pick-point hatching with island detection.
🤖 AI Agent Drivability: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) and JSON control channel support allow LLM agents to inspect drawings and execute drafting commands programmatically.
📁 Robust File Exchange: Native DXF parsing and DWG integration via the acadrust library, plus layout management and PDF plotting.

Use it to build custom engineering pipelines, embed blazing-fast CAD rendering into web apps, or let AI agents automate the generation of architectural floor plans and mechanical part drawings.

Check out the repository and start building today:
https://github.com/storytold/cadcraft

Tired of juggling fragmented data silos and paying a fortune for cloud-locked data warehouses? 💸

Meet Helix Foundry: an open-source, local-first knowledge graph and AI workspace that unifies all your disparate data sources onto your own hardware. 🚀

Whether you are pulling live data from PostgreSQL, MySQL, Stripe, PostHog, WorkOS, custom APIs, or local file uploads, Helix Foundry brings it all together into a single connected ontology and knowledge graph. 

Here is why developers and AI engineers are loving it:

🧠 Unified Ontology Engine: Automatically suggests and constructs connected graphs linking matching records across your tools.
🔒 100% Local-First & Private: Runs locally using Ollama and local models by default (with optional cloud support when you want it).
⚡ High-Performance DuckDB Queries: Leverages versioned immutable Parquet snapshots queried via isolated DuckDB processes.
🛠️ Developer Ready: Spin up a fully functioning local data warehouse instantly with an OpenAPI interface, TypeScript SDK, and automated CDC ingestion pipelines.

Build private internal AI assistants that query your company knowledge graph securely, or set up a local business intelligence dashboard without ever exposing your data to external cloud providers. 

Check out the repo, star the project, and start building locally today:
https://github.com/HelixDB/helix-foundry
